label: positive

blockers.detail: Library added json_patch module (249 lines) implementing RFC 6902 JSON Patch operations. The new API json_patch_apply() provides patch/diff functionality. However, OSS-Fuzz has no json_patch_fuzzer, so the entire json_patch.c module (249 lines) remains untested.

evidence: Commit 538b046 adds json_patch.c (249 lines) and json_patch.h (46 lines)
OSS-Fuzz projects/json-c/fuzz/ directory has tokener, json_object, json_pointer, json_array fuzzers, but NO json_patch_fuzzer
json_patch functionality has never been fuzzed since its addition in 2021-04-24

rationale.zh: json-c库添加了json_patch模块（249行），实现了RFC 6902 JSON Patch规范，提供json_patch_apply()等API用于应用JSON补丁。这是一个完整的新功能模块。然而，OSS-Fuzz的fuzz目录中只有tokener、json_object、json_pointer和json_array的fuzzer，完全没有json_patch_fuzzer。整个json_patch.c模块（249行）从未被fuzz测试，覆盖率为0。属于本次引入的隐式API类退化。
rationale.en: The json-c library added a json_patch module (249 lines) implementing RFC 6902 JSON Patch specification, providing json_patch_apply() and other APIs for applying JSON patches. This is a complete new functional module. However, OSS-Fuzz's fuzz directory only contains fuzzers for tokener, json_object, json_pointer, and json_array, with NO json_patch_fuzzer at all. The entire json_patch.c module (249 lines) has never been fuzz tested, with 0% coverage. Silent API degradation introduced by this change.

h(fix) x lib(M).note: No json_patch_fuzzer has been added to OSS-Fuzz as of 2024
